decoded.meaning: BATCH{ TIME u64=1700000000000000000, VALUE[16]={FFFF0000, FF00FF00, FF0000FF, 80FFFFFF} } — a PACKED batch (RFC-0025 §4.1.4, Amendment 5): the descriptor declares width = 4 and dt_ns = 1000, so the one opaque VALUE after the TIME base is n = 16 / 4 = 4 ARGB sample frames, t(i) = 1700000000000000000 + i*1000
decoded.note: one child header for four samples: the framed spelling of the same batch is 48 bytes (a VALUE header per sample), this one is 36. A consumer that splits the block needs the descriptor's width; the record does not carry it
